reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 再用纸托盘里的正反面

materials.title: Paper Reuse Trays 021
materials.text: At our paper station, sheets blank on one side go in the green tray. Sheets used on both sides go in the recycling box. Wet paper stays out of both. Take only two sheets for drawing. Ask before using paper with another child’s name. Keep the floor around the station clear.

questions.prompt: A friend has paper with a blank back. You say, "____"
options: Put it in the green tray.
Put it in the wet-paper pile.
questions.explanation: A单面空白可再用入绿盘；B不是湿纸，C全丢违再用分类。

questions.prompt: A friend puts wet paper with dry reusable sheets. You say, "____"
options: Keep wet paper out of this tray.
Draw on it with your shoes.
questions.explanation: B湿纸不入两容器；A加湿相反；C鞋作画非分类处理。

questions.prompt: A friend takes six sheets for one drawing. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C每次两张；A全部超限；B永不用纸非节制要求。

questions.prompt: A friend sees another child’s name on a sheet. You say, "____"
options: Use it and hide the name.
Write your name over it now.
questions.explanation: A带他人名先问；B隐藏、C覆盖姓名都没取得许可。

questions.prompt: A friend leaves a paper box in the path. You say, "____"
options: Leave it for someone to trip over.
Move it so the floor is clear.
Put more boxes in the path.
questions.explanation: B站点地面畅通需挪箱；A/B中A不清、C加堵都违要求。

materials.title: Measuring Flour Cups 021
materials.text: In cooking club, use the small blue cup for flour. Use the clear jug for water. Keep the flour dry until the teacher says to mix. Give each group one spoon. Wipe spilled flour from the table. The teacher puts trays in the oven; children stay at their tables.

questions.prompt: A friend takes the water jug for flour. You say, "____"
options: Use the small blue cup for flour.
questions.explanation: A蓝小杯量粉；B书包、C所有壶均非器具分工。

questions.prompt: A friend pours water into dry flour too soon. You say, "____"
options: Wait until the teacher says to mix.
Pour more water before anyone asks.
questions.explanation: B教师说混合前粉保持干；A/C提前混水违时机。

questions.prompt: A group takes three spoons. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C每组一勺；A五、B零均不符分配。

questions.prompt: A friend leaves flour spread on the table. You say, "____"
options: Leave it and throw more flour.
questions.explanation: A擦溢粉；B盖衣非擦净；C加撒违收拾。

questions.prompt: A friend carries a tray towards the oven. You say, "____"
options: Let the teacher handle the oven.
Open every hot tray with your hands.
questions.explanation: B烤箱由教师操作，学生留桌；A独放、C手开热盘均非分工。

units.title: 帽子上的花原来是纸的

materials.title: Flower Hat Stem 021
materials.text: I see a yellow flower on Mum’s hat. Its stem is bent. I think it needs water and bring a cup. Mum smiles and takes the hat off. The flower is made of paper. She straightens the wire inside the stem. The flower stands up again. I put the water on our real plant instead. Now I look more carefully before helping.

questions.prompt: The yellow flower is on Mum’s hat.
questions.explanation: A正确：yellow flower on hat；B否认位置。

questions.prompt: The writer first brings water for the flower.
questions.explanation: A正确：认为需水而bring cup；B否认最初帮助。

questions.prompt: Mum’s hat flower is a living plant.
questions.explanation: B正确：made of paper；A把仿花当活株。

questions.prompt: Mum straightens a wire in the stem.
questions.explanation: A正确：wire inside stem straighten；B否认恢复方式。

questions.prompt: The water is finally poured onto the paper flower.
questions.explanation: B正确：用于real plant instead；A弄错最终受水对象。

units.title: 旧地图包出的生日礼物

materials.title: Map Paper Gift Wrap 021
materials.text: Dad gives me an old map to wrap a present. Some roads on it are no longer the same, so we do not use it for our trip. I choose a part with a blue river. I put the map side outside and tie it with string. My friend likes the river picture. She opens the paper carefully and keeps it for making bookmarks later.

questions.prompt: The map is still chosen as the family’s current travel guide.
questions.explanation: B正确：路已变，不用于旅行；A把包装再用当现行指南。

questions.prompt: The writer chooses a part showing a blue river.
questions.explanation: A正确：part blue river；B否认图案选择。

questions.prompt: The plain side is outside and hides the map.
questions.explanation: B正确：map side outside；A正反颠倒。

questions.prompt: The present is tied with string.
questions.explanation: A正确：tie with string；B否认包装方式。

questions.prompt: The friend keeps the wrapping paper for another craft.
questions.explanation: A正确：keeps for bookmarks；B否认再用意图。

materials.title: Photo Ribbon Smile 021
materials.text: The class is ready for a photograph. Everyone says, "Smile!" but Tia looks worried. Ben thinks she does not want to be in the picture. He asks quietly. Tia points to a ribbon stuck in her jacket zip. It is pulling her hair. The teacher helps free it. Tia smiles at once. They take the photo a minute later. Ben is glad he asked instead of deciding what her face meant. Tia asks him to stand beside her in the picture.

questions.prompt: Why does Ben first think Tia is worried?
options: He thinks she does not want the photograph.
He knows she has lost a book.
He thinks the camera is broken.
questions.explanation: A未笑被误认为不愿合照；B丢书、C坏相机非其初猜。

questions.prompt: What is the actual problem?
options: A ribbon in her zip is pulling her hair.
questions.explanation: B丝带夹拉链扯头发；A颜色、C失鞋无据。

questions.prompt: Who helps free the ribbon?
questions.explanation: C教师帮助解开；A/B无此角色。

questions.prompt: When is the photograph taken?
options: A minute later, after the problem is solved.
questions.explanation: A一分钟后解好再拍；B到前、C下冬均不符。

questions.prompt: What does Ben learn from asking Tia?
options: A face does not always reveal the cause of a feeling.
Everyone must smile all the time.
questions.explanation: B问后发现并非不愿拍，脸色不足知原因；A禁交谈、C强迫常笑非故事意思。

units.title: 教室物品、动作与感受的分类

materials.title: Indoor Word Categories 021
materials.text: Choose the word that matches each description. There is only one correct word in each group.

questions.prompt: Which word names something used to fasten a coat?
questions.explanation: A button钮扣可扣外套；B山谷、C火箭不作衣扣。

questions.prompt: Which word describes a feeling?
questions.explanation: B nervous紧张为情绪；A木制为材料，C三角为形状。

questions.prompt: Which word names an action done with a pencil?
questions.explanation: C sketch画草图是铅笔可做动作；A多云为天气；B车站为地点。

questions.prompt: Which word names a container for hot drinks?
questions.explanation: A mug杯盛热饮；B小山非容器；C手套穿戴不盛饮料。

questions.prompt: Which word describes the opposite of heavy?
questions.explanation: B light轻与heavy重相反；A响反quiet，C晚反early，均不答重量对立。

materials.title: Library Return Shelf Arrow 021
materials.text: The library has a low shelf for returned books. A new helper sees an arrow pointing down and puts the books on the floor below it. The librarian explains that the arrow points to the low shelf, not the floor. She adds the words "Return books on this shelf." They move the arrow closer to the shelf edge. Later, three pupils use it correctly. The librarian keeps watching for a few days before saying the new sign is clear to everyone.

questions.prompt: Returned books belong on the low shelf.
questions.explanation: A正确：low shelf returned books；B否认规则。

questions.prompt: The helper puts books on the floor because the arrow is unclear to them.
questions.explanation: A正确：下箭被理解地面，管理员解释；B否认误读原因。

questions.prompt: The librarian adds words and moves the arrow closer.
questions.explanation: A正确：加说明并移近架边；B否认两项调整。

questions.prompt: The next three correct uses prove every future pupil will understand.
questions.explanation: B正确：仍继续看几日，不凭三次宣称人人懂；A夸大样本。

questions.prompt: The librarian stops checking immediately after changing the sign.
questions.explanation: B正确：keeps watching a few days；A提前终止与原文相反。

units.title: 空画框给出的另一种风景

materials.title: Cardboard Frame Story 021
materials.text:
Ravi made a cardboard frame for the school art walk. He planned to put his neatest drawing inside it. On the way to the display, the drawing slipped from his bag into a puddle. Its colours ran together. He thought the project was ruined.
His friend Alia held up the empty frame towards a row of trees. "We could frame something that is already here," she said. Ravi first thought this was cheating because they had not painted the trees. Their teacher explained that choosing a view could also be part of an art project, as long as they described what they had done honestly. Ravi wrote "A changing view, chosen by us" beneath the frame. Visitors saw moving leaves instead of a fixed picture. He kept the damaged drawing too, but did not pretend that the empty-frame idea had been his original plan.

questions.prompt: What goes wrong with Ravi’s drawing?
options: It falls into a puddle and the colours run.
questions.explanation: B滑落水洼颜色散；A化树、C教师丢、D朋友取均无据。

questions.prompt: What does Alia propose?
options: Blame the rain in a speech.
Use the frame to select a real view.
questions.explanation: C框已有树景；A秘密临摹、B演讲责雨、D取消均非提议。

questions.prompt: What condition does the teacher give?
options: Describe honestly what the project does.
Claim they painted the actual trees.
Hide the fact that there is no picture.
questions.explanation: A诚实描述选景；B冒称画树、C隐瞒、D毁初画违后续保留。

questions.prompt: What makes the final framed view different from a fixed drawing?
options: It always looks exactly the same.
It can only be seen indoors.
questions.explanation: D动叶不断变；A可见树叶；B不恒定；C在艺术步行户外。

questions.prompt: How does Ravi present the new idea’s origin?
options: As the plan he had always intended.
As a change after his first plan failed.
As a copy made without Alia.
questions.explanation: B不假称初计划，接受事后转向；A正被否定；C确用了；D朋友有贡献。

units.title: 班级会议记录里的两种句子

materials.title: Council Minute Action 021
materials.text: At the class meeting, several pupils suggested a quiet game corner. One wanted beanbags, another wanted a low table, and a third asked for chess sets. The secretary wrote all three ideas under "Suggestions." The class agreed only to try one chess table for two weeks. That decision went under "Agreed action," with the names of two helpers and a start date. When the notes were posted, one pupil thought every suggestion had been approved. The secretary added a short explanation of the two headings. The notes kept all ideas visible without presenting them as promises the class had made.

questions.prompt: All three suggestions were immediately approved as actions.
questions.explanation: B正确：只同意试一棋桌；A把建议列表当全部批准。

questions.prompt: The agreed action had a trial length of two weeks.
questions.explanation: A正确：one chess table two weeks；B否认试行期限。

questions.prompt: The decision note named helpers and a start date.
questions.explanation: A正确：two helpers names start date；B否认落实信息。

questions.prompt: The secretary removed every unapproved idea from the notes.
questions.explanation: B正确：kept all ideas visible；A把分类解释当删除。

questions.prompt: The two headings distinguish ideas from commitments.
questions.explanation: A正确：Suggestions与Agreed action避免当承诺；B否认记录作用。

units.title: 果园里两把不同的梯子

materials.title: Harvest Ladders Story 021
materials.text:
In the orchard, Lina wanted to use the tallest ladder because it reached the highest apples. Her uncle asked her to carry fruit baskets while he and another adult checked the ladders. One tall ladder had a loose step. A shorter one was in good condition but could not reach every branch.
Lina felt the shorter ladder would make the work slower. Her uncle agreed, then explained that speed was not the only condition for choosing a tool. They marked the damaged ladder and set it aside for repair. The adults used the sound shorter ladder and a long picking tool for the remaining branches. Lina helped sort the fruit on the ground.
At the end, a few high apples remained. Lina expected her uncle to be annoyed. Instead, he said they had finished the work they could do with suitable equipment that day. He would return after the repair, rather than turn an unfinished task into a reason to use an unsuitable ladder. Lina looked at the few apples differently: they marked a limit to respect, not a failure to hide.

questions.prompt: Why does Lina first prefer the tall ladder?
options: It belongs to a famous painter.
questions.explanation: B想够最高果；A颜色、C无阶、D画家归属均无据。

questions.prompt: What problem is found?
options: The shorter ladder is made of paper.
A tall ladder has a loose step.
All apples are on the ground.
questions.explanation: C高梯一阶松；A/B/D非检查结果。

questions.prompt: What does Lina do during the harvesting work?
options: Help with baskets and sort fruit on the ground.
Repair the ladder without an adult.
questions.explanation: A地面搬篮分果；B/C/D均未发生，成人负责梯检查和使用。

questions.prompt: Why are a few apples left?
options: The uncle has forgotten the orchard.
The available suitable equipment does not reach everything.
questions.explanation: D现有适用设备有界限；A厌果、B忘园、C藏篮非原因。

questions.prompt: What does Lina learn from her uncle?
options: Finishing fast matters more than equipment condition.
A task’s limit should not justify an unsuitable tool.
All unfinished work must be hidden.
questions.explanation: B不能因未完强用不合工具；A安全条件被明确考虑；C不需隐藏；D计划修后返。

units.title: 新同学指南的称呼变化

materials.title: Newcomer School Guide 021
materials.text:
The welcome team wrote a guide for new pupils. The first draft said, "Ask your parents to print this form and drive you to the meeting." During review, pupils pointed out that some children lived with grandparents or other carers, and some families did not have a printer or car. The team changed the instruction to "Ask the adult who supports you to help complete the form. Paper copies are available at the office."
They also gave the meeting’s bus route and walking entrance. The guide did not assume that every family would arrive in the same way. The original goal—getting forms completed before the meeting—stayed the same. The team made the route to that goal more realistic for different households.

questions.prompt: The first draft assumed access to a printer and car.
questions.explanation: A正确：要求家长打印并开车；B否认假设。

questions.prompt: Every pupil in the school lived with parents who had the same resources.
questions.explanation: B正确：有祖辈或其他照顾者，部分无车打印机；A泛化相反。

questions.prompt: Paper forms became available at the office.
questions.explanation: A正确：新文明确paper copies office；B否认替代渠道。

questions.prompt: The revision abandoned the need to complete forms before the meeting.
questions.explanation: B正确：goal stayed same；A把改途径当取消目标。

questions.prompt: Bus and walking information helped avoid a single transport assumption.
questions.explanation: A正确：补公交和步行入口，非全开车；B否认信息作用。

units.title: 旧台灯说明书的型号核对

materials.title: Repair Manual Model Number 021
materials.text:
The design club found an old lamp and a manual that looked as if it belonged to it. Both showed the same brand name. A pupil wanted to follow the manual to change a part. The teacher asked them to compare the model numbers first. The lamp was Model 24, while the manual was for Model 42.
The drawings looked similar, but the switch and cable position differed. The club stopped the repair plan and asked a qualified repairer to inspect the lamp. He found the correct instructions and explained which checks he needed to make. Pupils observed and wrote notes; they did not work on the electrical parts themselves. The wrong manual was labelled clearly and filed with its own model number, rather than left beside the lamp again. The club’s report said that a familiar brand and similar appearance were clues, not enough evidence that instructions matched.

questions.prompt: Why did a pupil initially think the manual matched?
options: It had the same brand and similar appearance.
It had already passed a professional check.
questions.explanation: A品牌相同图近似导致初猜；B尚未检；C24与42不同；D非教师编写。

questions.prompt: What mismatch was found?
options: Both items were from different planets.
questions.explanation: B台灯24手册42；A有品牌；C有手册图；D无幻想设定。

questions.prompt: What did the club do next?
options: Ask a qualified repairer to inspect it.
Sell the manual as correct for every lamp.
questions.explanation: C找合格维修者；A学生不电修；B不猜；D没泛售。

questions.prompt: What was the pupils’ role during the check?
questions.explanation: D观察记录；A未操作电件；B不改号；C错册明确归档。

questions.prompt: What is the report’s main conclusion?
options: Instructions need more than familiar appearance to establish a match.
No repaired object can ever be used.
questions.explanation: A品牌近似不充分，需型号等核对；B未全否品牌；C全适用相反；D未说永不可用。
